item.title: Violet: an Astro Starlight plugin for planning work with AI agents
item.description:
I’m happy to announce my new personal project: Violet, which is a plugin for Starlight, Astro’s documentation framework. Violet is for the notes that live beside your code: plans, decisions, runbooks, and handoffs. It takes the Markdown files already sitting in your repo and turns them into a documentation site you can actually read. It’s named after “Violet”, a song by Savage Garden.

What it does

Violet reads your notes folder in place. You don’t move any files. On top of that it adds:
